title: M-FSK Demodulator Baseband
text: Demodulate FSK-modulated data, 1 input, 1 output, {Output data type} sets Output data type; {M-ary number} sets the number of frequencies in modulated signal, {Output type} sets the integer or group of bits output indicator, {Symbol set ordering} sets the symbol mapping, {Frequency separation (Hz)} sets the frequency separation in Hz, {Samples per symbol} sets the symbol sampling rate and {Rate options} sets the block processing rate Enforce single-rate. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Out
ports.summary: Demodulated output signal scalar | column vector

params.name: M-ary number
params.values: Number of frequencies in modulated signal 8 (default) | positive integer ≥ 2

params.name: Output type
params.values: Integer or group of bits output indicator Integer (default) | Bit

params.name: Frequency separation (Hz)
params.values: Frequency separation in Hz 6 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Rate options
params.values: Block processing rate Enforce single-rate processing (default) | Allow multirate processing

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Output data type double (default) | boolean | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32
